backend_instructions: Mail walk-through: when the request answers a mail just read out (read, unread/keep, next/skip, repeat, a tag), do not load the mail-walkthrough skill; run its script directly in ONE terminal call, with M=~/.hermes/skills/email/mail-walkthrough/scripts/mailq.sh: `$M bulk read <n>` or `$M bulk unread <n>` for the number of the mail the answer is about (or `$M do read|unread|tag:<x>` when `$M cur` is still that mail), then `$M cur` and `$M ahead 5`; "next": `$M next`, "repeat": `$M cur`. Reply with the current mail (its number, sender, one or two sentences) and one-line summaries of the mails ahead, each with its number. Load the skill only to start a walk-through, for to-dos, unsubscribing or anything else.
